about_the_game:
Your Objectives

In this incremental game, playing as a Growmancer, your goal is to transform the surface by covering it with grass, extinguishing dangerous wildfires, and then making the land fertile – let all the flowers bloom! You'll need these flowers to progress through an extensive skill tree.

Your Companion

Your four-legged friend will accompany you across all the worlds you bring to life. And yes, its abilities can also be upgraded in the skill tree. This magical dog embodies the classic automation approach common in this genre – it handles tasks automatically, requiring no direct control.

Choose Your Difficulty

The game features two distinct modes:

  • Relaxation Mode: Perfect for unwinding. Transform the land, manage emerging fires, collect flowers, upgrade your power, and enjoy a mostly stress-free experience.

  • Challenge Mode: This mode introduces a real test of skill. You'll need to make timely and smart decisions, strategically battling raging wildfires alongside your greening efforts, to avoid defeat. Retry again and again to beat your previous high score!

So, here's what awaits you:

  • The Growmancer: A wizard wandering desolate worlds with the goal of transforming them into vibrant gardens while keeping destructive fires under control.

  • A Four-Legged Companion: Your loyal canine friend assists you on your journey.

  • Incremental Upgrades: Collect flowers to spend in the skill tree, unlocking upgrades for both the Growmancer and the dog.

  • Core Mechanics: Transform land, fight wildfires, collect resources, and upgrade abilities.

  • Multiple Game Modes: Choose between a relaxing experience and a skill-based challenge.

  • Elements of Random Generation: Ensures variety across playthroughs.

  • Playtime: Roughly 2 hours for a single playthrough, but countless hours for those looking to replay, master the challenge mode, or achieve full completion.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows® 10 64-bit (latest Service Pack)
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i3 or AMD Phenom™ X3 8650
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 600 series, AMD Radeon™ HD 7000 series
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: A small incremental game about greening the land. Play as the Growmancer, a wizard traveling worlds with his canine companion to transform wastelands into fertile grounds and battle destructive wildfires. Upgrade both via a skill tree. Challenge yourself or just relax.
supported_languages:
English*, French*, German*, Spanish - Spain*, Portuguese - Portugal*, Russian*, Simplified Chinese*
*languages with full audio support
